recognize_zh: 核為偏心的圓至卵圓形、無凹陷，染色質有粗塊聚集而無明確核仁，細胞質豐富偏藍並布滿細小的粉紅／淡紫色顆粒，是骨髓細胞（myelocyte）。
features: Large cell, over twice the diameter of adjacent red cells
Moderately condensed chromatin with a few coarse chromatin clumps; no definite nucleoli
Abundant, slightly basophilic cytoplasm filled with fine pink-lilac secondary granules and a small clear area
Background red cells with mild crenation of a few cells
describe_en: High-power smear shows a large granulocytic precursor with an eccentric round-to-oval nucleus lacking indentation. The chromatin is moderately condensed with a few coarse clumps, and no definite nucleoli are seen. The cytoplasm is abundant and slightly basophilic, containing numerous fine pink-lilac secondary granules. Findings are consistent with a myelocyte, which in peripheral blood indicates a left shift or marrow stress/infiltration.

ddx.vs: Promyelocytes have finer chromatin with nucleoli, a perinuclear hof and coarse dark azurophilic granules.
Metamyelocytes have an indented, kidney-shaped nucleus with more condensed chromatin.
Plasma cells are smaller with clock-face chromatin, deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm and a paranuclear hof.
